spy_levels.sentence: Sellers had plenty of reference points to start a bigger move: prior week low, the 686 equal low, and the breakout pivot.
The weekly line in the sand for a true trend reversal is 675.
This week’s expected move upper bound is 702.66, which would imply a daily higher high.
That’s still a slightly higher low versus last week, but it is beneath the short term “comfort zone” of 686.
Friday's close then complicates this with a recapture of the 686 and daily 50 SMA.
There is the threat of a daily lower high under the 20 SMA near 690.75 as a rejection level to watch.
The hourly trend flipped back to up quickly after a double bottom neckline break and hold early Friday morning over 681.5 and reclaim of 686.

If we hold above 686, the base case is an hourly higher low and continued rotation.
686 is also confluence with the daily 50 SMA.
If Monday closes below 686 and Tuesday opens below it, expect a retest of the broader range lows.
